decision: founder 11/10/2026: X3 boot keeps the 15/09 Bayer look with the lockup split into 100/50/30 tones; X3 sleep uses the hybrid (softer background fade, Bayer background and grain, tenor/ink lockup and mark)

origin.font: Geist Medium and Regular copied to fonts/ with OFL.txt; the 15/09 pages loaded the same two files through absolute file:// URLs outside this repo; here they load from fonts/ next to the pages

changes_from_260915.khoi-dong.html: .lockup .ns color #808080 (50%), .lockup .sl color #4D4D4D (30%); everything else and the stored grain unchanged
changes_from_260915.muc-dang.html: background gradient #FFFFFF 0%, #FFFFFF 26%, #F6F6F6 33%, #E8E8E8 40%, #CFCFCF 48%, #B0B0B0 57%, #787878 68%, #3C3C3C 81%, #000000 92%, #000000 100%; .lockup .ns #808080, .lockup .sl #B3B3B3; grain regenerated by render.py for the new background (seed 20260915)

pipeline.sleep_one_bit: src/components/ManNguTenor.h is the sleep gray planes of X3BrandAssets.h folded to black and white by the SleepGrayPlanes::show rule (scripts/sinh_man_ngu.py reads the planes, so it follows the sleep art); test/brand_boot/x3_art.py folds the sleep BMP itself and compares every pixel
pipeline.sleep: background, grain, large plus: Chrome scale 1 and Bayer; lockup and mark: Chrome scale 4, BOX to 528x792, tenor/ink 4 levels, mask = pixels darker than 250 in a shot with only lockup and mark, dilated by 1 pixel
pipeline.tenor_ink: tenor_ink.py reproduces lib/JpegToBmpConverter/TenorInk.cpp on the sleep shot (0 of 418176 pixels differ, measured with test/tenor_ink/Kernel.cpp)
pipeline.rebuild: scripts/brand-art/x3/build.sh (needs Google Chrome, Pillow, numpy, scipy); it runs render.py, scripts/pack_x3_brand.py, then scripts/sinh_man_ngu.py (also needs 7zz) for the one bit sleep frame

lockup_mean_gray_boot.note: 4x4 window inside a stroke; the firmware Bayer cut at 64 maps tone 77 (30%) to 53.1, so the slash reads 0.208 of cross while tenor reads 0.500
